versions.changelog: Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Bumped version to 1.1.1.
- Minor documentation updates in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md.
- No changes to core functionality or commands.

- Added documentation for new device-code authentication via dlazy login, making setup easier and copy/paste unnecessary.
- Manual API key setup remains, now clearly marked as an alternative method.
- No changes to commands, output, or error handling.
- Version bumped to 1.1.0.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated agent instructions for handling missing or unauthorized API keys: agents must now save the provided API key using `dlazy auth set <key>` and resume the task.
- Improved clarity in error handling and recharge instructions for insufficient balance.
- Minor documentation adjustments in SKILL.md, SKILL-en.md, and SKILL-cn.md for consistency.

- Added an authentication section with instructions for setting and obtaining the dLazy API key.
- Updated CLI install requirement to @dlazy/cli@1.0.6.
- Improved documentation for setup and usage in all supported languages.

- Initial release of dlazy-recraft-v3 skill.
- Supports diverse design style image generation using Recraft v3, including text-to-image and image-to-image options.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, trigger keywords, and command-line options.
- Provides structured output format and robust error handling guidance.
- Critical agent instructions for handling insufficient balance and missing API key scenarios.
